description: Search Czech companies by structured filters (name, postal code, municipality, legal form, CZ-NACE). At least one filter is required to avoid full-registry scans. Returns paginated results with totals.

czNace.description: List of CZ-NACE classification codes (e.g. ['620'] for IT activities).

obchodniJmeno.description: Full or partial company name (full-text search).

pravniForma.description: List of legal-form codes (e.g. ['112'] for s.r.o., ['121'] for a.s.).

sidloKodObce.description: Numeric municipality code (RÚIAN). Use ares_lookup_czNace or your own lookup if unknown.

sidloPsc.description: Postal code of the registered seat, e.g. '11000' or '110 00'.

name: ares_search_companies
